notes: Modified cash basis governmental funds; business-type (Water, Sewer, Trash) on accrual basis (Statement of Activities shows business-type activities on accrual basis), so business_type uses the proprietary statement (net position) and proprietary cash flows Total column (pp8-9). Governmental receipts/disbursements from Total Governmental Funds column (p5); transfers_in is the printed net Total column 44,070 (Sales Tax -> General 20,000 nets to zero; Water -> Street 44,070). Governmental cash: Balance Sheet p4 Cash and cash equivalents 323,939, CDs 13,528 (ending_investments) and County treasurer cash 14,016 printed separately (not added to ending_cash); beginning cash not printed. Balance sheet: government-wide Statement of Net Position (p1), since it includes capital assets; governmental funds balance sheet totals differ. General Fund detail from the departmental combining statement (p13, more detailed than the p10 budget schedule, which is not recorded to avoid double counting). Street and Sales Tax Fund from their budget schedules (pp11-12). Utility detail from the proprietary statement fund columns (p7; no utility budget schedules); expenditure totals per fund from Statement of Activities expenses (p2). Read pages 1-13 of 13
